1) INFO clients 对比 connected_clients 与 C: 1) Compare connected_clients from INFO clients against CONFIG GET maxclients; 2) Use CLIENT LIST grouped by source address to find the application leaking connections; 3) As an emergency measure run CONFIG SET maxclients <larger value>, confirming the system ulimit -n is high enough; 4) For the root cause, cap the application connection pool and enable connection reuse.
1) INFO memory 确认 used_memory_rss 与碎片率 m: 1) Check used_memory_rss and the fragmentation ratio mem_fragmentation_ratio in INFO memory — enable activedefrag if fragmentation is high; 2) Use redis-cli --bigkeys / --memkeys to find big keys and split them or add TTLs; 3) Check whether keys without an expiry are piling up; 4) Confirm maxmemory-policy, then scale up memory or shard as needed.
1) SLOWLOG GET 10 找耗时最高的命令；2) 重点排查 KEYS、: 1) Run SLOWLOG GET 10 to find the slowest commands; 2) Focus on O(N) commands such as KEYS, HGETALL and SMEMBERS and on big-key operations, switching to SCAN or batched processing; 3) Check INFO persistence to see whether an RDB/AOF rewrite fork is causing the stall; 4) Check whether the host CPU is saturated or the machine is swapping.
1) 先排除刚重启或刚扩容导致的冷启动（对照 redis_uptime_in_s: 1) First rule out a cold start after a restart or scale-out (check redis_uptime_in_seconds); 2) Compare the growth of keyspace_hits and keyspace_misses in INFO stats to tell unwarmed new keys apart from heavy eviction; 3) If an eviction alert fired at the same time, treat it as insufficient memory (scale up or clean up big keys); 4) Review the cache key design and whether the TTL is too short on the application side.
1) 查看 Redis 日志确认是被 OOM killer 干掉、崩溃还是人工重: 1) Check the Redis log to tell an OOM kill, a crash and a manual restart apart; 2) If the system OOM killer was involved, compare maxmemory against free host memory and lower maxmemory; 3) Confirm the RDB/AOF loaded correctly and the data is complete (check rdb_last_load_keys_loaded in INFO persistence); 4) After the restart, watch the hit rate and the backend database load, and warm the cache if needed.
1) 用 CLIENT LIST 按来源地址统计连接，定位占用最多的应用；2): 1) Use CLIENT LIST grouped by source address to find the application holding the most connections; 2) Tell a scale-out apart from a connection pool leak (many idle connections never released); 3) As an emergency measure run CONFIG SET maxclients <larger value> and check the system ulimit -n to match; 4) For the root cause, cap the application connection pool and enable connection reuse.
1) 用 INFO memory 看 used_memory 与 maxmemo: 1) Use INFO memory to compare used_memory against maxmemory and confirm whether it has topped out; 2) Use redis-cli --bigkeys to find abnormally large keys and clean up or split them; 3) Confirm maxmemory-policy matches expectations (allkeys-lru for a pure cache; data you cannot afford to lose must not be left evictable); 4) If capacity is genuinely insufficient, scale up memory or shard.
1) 用 redis-cli --latency 和 SLOWLOG GET 1: 1) Use redis-cli --latency and SLOWLOG GET 10 to check whether slow commands (KEYS, HGETALL, big-key operations) are blocking the main thread; 2) Check INFO persistence to see whether an RDB/AOF rewrite fork is causing the stall; 3) Check whether the host CPU is saturated or the machine is swapping; 4) Once you find the slow command, replace it with SCAN or batched operations.
Redis 内存已用到 maxmemory 的 85%，继续增长会触发大量 ke: Redis memory usage has reached 85% of maxmemory; further growth will trigger heavy key eviction, or reject writes outright under the noeviction policy.
Redis 命令平均耗时超过 250ms，主线程被慢命令或阻塞操作占住，所有请求: The average Redis command takes more than 250ms; the main thread is occupied by slow or blocking operations and every request is affected.
Redis 在 10 分钟内重启过，重启会丢失内存中未持久化的数据并清空缓存，回: Redis restarted within the last 10 minutes; the restart lost any unpersisted in-memory data and cleared the cache, so origin load will spike for a while.
Redis 正在大量驱逐 key，缓存命中率会随之下降，未命中的请求会回源打到后: Redis is evicting keys heavily; the cache hit rate will fall and the missed requests will hit the backend database.
Redis 正在拒绝新连接，说明连接数已达 maxclients 上限，客户端会: Redis is rejecting new connections, which means the connection count has reached maxclients and clients get connection failures.
客户端连接数已达 maxclients 的 85%，触顶后新连接会被直接拒绝。: Client connections have reached 85% of maxclients; once it tops out new connections are rejected outright.
缓存命中率跌破 90%，未命中的请求会直接回源到后端数据库，后端负载与响应时间随: The cache hit rate has fallen below 90%; missed requests go straight to the backend database, raising its load and response time.
采集端 PING Redis 的往返耗时超过 100ms，说明主线程被阻塞或网络: The collector's PING round trip to Redis exceeds 100ms, which means the main thread is blocked or the network is degraded — every command slows down accordingly.
